# Daily Report — 2026-09-03

## Task Completed
Implemented `create_pa_indicator` tool (POST pa_indicator).

A new Performance Analytics indicator can now be created via MCP. The tool
accepts all key indicator fields: name (required), description, table,
condition, formula, frequency, direction, active, unit, and indicator_group.
Direction aliases (maximize/maximise/minimize/minimise) are normalised to
ServiceNow's numeric codes ('1'/'2').  None-valued optional fields are
excluded from the POST body.  The tool is registered in the
`system_administrator` and `full` tool packages.
